description: This file defines the implementation of an implicit stream subscriber grain in Orleans. It subscribes to a stream, tracks received items and errors, and interacts with a counter grain to monitor activity.

classes.name: ImplicitSubscriberGrain
classes.description: An Orleans Grain implementing stream subscription observer that tracks message count and errors.

methods.name: GetCounterValue
methods.description: Returns the current value of a specified counter (requests or errors).

methods.name: OnCompletedAsync
methods.description: Handles stream completion; currently does nothing.

methods.name: OnErrorAsync
methods.description: Handles errors in the stream; logs the error and increments the error counter.

methods.name: OnNextAsync
methods.description: Processes incoming stream items; logs trace if enabled and increments request counter.

methods.name: OnSubscribed
methods.description: Callback when the subscription is established; tracks the grain and resumes the subscription handle.
